A1.justification: Both PDFs describe H3DP and contain complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, experiments, tables, and figures without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original results on 44 simulation tasks and four real-world manipulation tasks, alongside generalization experiments, ablations, and additional appendix comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains original simulation and real-world results in Section 4, with further experimental results and analyses in Appendices D–E.

M1.justification: The depth layering, multi-scale visual encoding, hierarchical diffusion procedure, training objectives, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Capitalizing 'Depth-Aware Layering' does not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 44 tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, Adroit, DexArt, and RoboTwin, plus the same four real-world tasks. Instance generalization, segmentation conditions, and depth-variation scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: DP, DP with depth, and DP3 remain the main baselines, with the same CARP, DP-DINOv2, and GMM-layering comparisons in Appendix E.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, episode counts, checkpoint evaluation schedules, demonstration quantities, model configurations, and preprocessing conditions match. The real-world randomization ranges and evaluation procedures are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same component and layer-count ablations, action spectral analysis, segmentation sensitivity tests, depth-variation analysis, and inference-speed comparisons. Moving Table 15 adds no analysis.

E5.justification: The three-seed reporting in Section 4.1.1 and Appendix E is unchanged, as are the plus/minus reporting in Tables 1 and 19 and shaded learning curves in Figure 6. No statistical procedure or run information is added.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains averages of 75.6 for H3DP and 59.3 for DP3; relocated Table 15 retains segmentation-condition averages of 82.8 and 54.3.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), mathematical definitions, loss formulations, and diffusion reasoning are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes a theorem, proof, or derivation relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same three-hierarchy contribution and performance/generalization claims, including the reported 27.5% relative simulation improvement.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of the experiments are unchanged, including DP3's segmentation sensitivity. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning diffusion inference speed and ZED depth quality.

D1.justification: Appendices A–D retain the same hyperparameters, encoding details, demonstration counts, asynchronous execution, temporal ensembling, and p-masking instructions. Hardware descriptions and the project-page link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 67 references are unchanged. No prior work or novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: Section 3.1 and Figure 2 change 'Depth-aware Layering' to 'Depth-Aware Layering,' and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The prose and section structure otherwise match.

P2.justification: Table 15 moves from between its discussion paragraphs to the top of page 20, before both paragraphs. Figure 2 receives a capitalization edit; figures and tables retain the same substantive content.

improvement.justification: v2 makes small capitalization and layout adjustments, principally relocating Table 15. The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged, so these cosmetic edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
